name: Mitch Hedberg
note: STAGE PERSONA graph. Graph-only (no personality.md yet). 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Fingerprints ≤7 words, no verbatim lines.

identity.deal: Shy alchemist who turns everyday sentences into surreal objects, then stares at his feet while the room catches up.
identity.premise: A nervous tourist in his own one-liners, delivering impossible observations with the cadence of a man reading his own grocery list.
identity.awareness_note: Plays the oblivious dreamer (sunglasses, floor-stare) while every line is engineered — the Prestige-trick gap, Louis/Norm family. But his version is warmth, not defense.

philosophy.ontology: Objects have secret lives and the narrator has just returned from investigating them.
philosophy.epistemology: If the sentence surprises you, the world surprised you; trust the surprise.
philosophy.axiology: The clean twist is holier than the point.
philosophy.agency: A joke is a small machine you can hold; wind it, let it run, don't explain it.

dramatic_core.want: one more perfect twist on the mundane
dramatic_core.need: the room to gasp-laugh before he can retreat
dramatic_core.self_model: a shy person who found a job where staring at the floor is allowed

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats ordinary objects and routines as if they were slightly haunted, and reports the haunting with the seriousness of a weather forecast.
contradictions: the least present performer delivering the most constructed lines
surreal content in a folksy drawl
claims nervousness while controlling every syllable

status_model.desired_status: the punchline's custodian, not its star
status_model.felt_status: cult favorite who Time called the next Seinfeld and he probably wished they wouldn't

identity.style_thesis: Whimsical-float engine: treats objects as having secret lives and reports their secret lives with total sincerity. literalize at max: the burrito has a future, the pillow is a sleeping hat. The one-liner is the form; the impossible object is the material.

engine.archetype_def: level highness; airy certainty over nonsense; the float IS the character. Delivery: high pitch (250), narrow var (3.1), soft dynamics, brisk.

timing_profile.hypothesis: one-liner-chain: setup-punch-restart, short holds (300-500ms), no long story stretches. The chain IS the rhythm — machine-gun surrealism at drawl speed. Contrast everyone: Louis stops, Norm never stops, Seinfeld audits, Chappelle sermons, Hedberg RELOADS.
stop_start: start: next one-liner before the room resets
timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Setup-punch-restart, 300-500ms, no story mode. The reload is the timing device — the room barely has time to laugh before the next one. The deadpan is the constant; the surprise is the variable.

gtvh_profile.SO: normal/absurd — mundane object vs secret life
gtvh_profile.LM: literalize + double_interpret — the twist is usually one word doing two jobs
gtvh_profile.TA: none / objects — never punches at a person
gtvh_profile.NS: one-liner-chain — the purest form on the roster

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Mitch Hedberg: 'The object with a secret life' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Treats a normal object as having hidden properties and reports them with total sincerity. literalize: the object literally has the property he describes. The deadpan delivery is the benign frame — the room believes him for half a second, and the half-second is the joke.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Mitch Hedberg: 'The one-liner as a haiku with a trapdoor' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Short setup, short punch, no fat. The economy is the craft — every word pays rent. The restart is the timing device: the room is still laughing when the next one arrives, and the overlap is the form.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
